title: <input type=file multiple> extensions
body:
https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#the-multiple-attribute

> 4\.10\.5\.3\.5 The multiple attribute

## `<input type=file multiple>`

## Problem

The `multiple` attribute does not allow the `input` field to control the number of files actually selectable. 

The developer is stuck with, either no `multiple` attribute which means 1 file selectable, or a `multiple` attribute which means N files selectable. There is nothing between 1 and N.

## Proposal 1

Allow the `multiple` attribute to accept an integer N as a value, with N > 0.

Ex : `<input type=file multiple=3>` allows a maximum of 3 files to be selected

## Challenges

Some challenges reside in the way the User Agent (UA) will provide feedback to the user, given the number of files currently selected, and the limits described in the `input` field.
- How does the UA controls the number of files, with the keyboard, when using a continous selection (select first file, then select Maj + last file on Windows) ? 
- How does the UA controls the number of files, with the keyboard, when using a discrete selection (N x {Ctrl + select file} on Windows) ? 
- How does the UA controls the number of files, with the keyboard, when using a total selection (Ctrl + A on Windows) ? 
- How does the interface control the number of files, with the mouse ? 
- Should the UA show a counter of currently selected files ? (Ex : 2 files selected on 3)
- Should the UA show a counter of remaining selectable files ? (Ex : 1 file remaining)

## Proposal 2

This last question opens the possibility of indicating a minimum number of files.

The proposal becomes:

Allow the `multiple` attribute to be used in conjonction with two new `min` and `max` attributes, `min` accepting an integer N as a value, with N > 0, `max` accepting an integer N as a value, with N >= `min`.

Ex : `<input type=file multiple min=3 max=10>` allows 3 to 10 files to be selected

Sometimes, `max` can be equal to `min`. Use case: Please upload a recto and a verso of you ID card. In this configuration, `min=2` and `max=2`.

Ex : `<input type=file multiple min=2 max=2>` allows strictly 2 files to be selected

This solution is more flexible that the previous one.

Whatever the chosen solution is, the `<input type=file multiple...>` seems to have to evolve, in order to adapt to these new usages.
